feeds.title: Motherhood Later
feeds.description: Motherhood Later.. Than Sooner, founded by Robin Gorman Newman, is an international organization for women who had a baby over 35. Our mission is to support, empower, inform and connect midlife mothers through our website, blog, newsletter, learning opportunities, online communities for later moms, and in-person events for midlife mothers and families.

feeds.title: Pregnancy Stories By Age
feeds.description: Collection of personal stories of pregnancy and birth over 40. If so rare, so impossible, such a miracle - why can I find so many stories? Offering inspiration, hope, and comfort to those trying to conceive over 40 years old.

feeds.title: Midlife Margaritas » Parenting
feeds.description: Midlife Margaritas share tales of my insane family life and write about midlife, marriage, parenting older kids and anything else in a satirical way.

feeds.title: Midlife Singlemum
feeds.description: This a blog about a woman for whom not being a mother was unacceptable. Add to the mix that I'm also an Expat, Jewish, British, Israeli, Single, a Teacher, a Writer, a Homemaker, an almost Vegetarian, a recent Minimalist, and you have Midlife Singlemum.

feeds.title: MomAgain@40
feeds.description: MomAgain@40 is a blog trying to wade through all the info about raising kids for parents in their mid-forties. Here, the author Karen gives you all deets and advice on parenting and much more.

feeds.title: Mum in a Nutshell
feeds.description: Mum, in a Nutshell, is a family lifestyle blog by Devon's single mum. Here, you'll find articles on homes, healthy lifestyles, relationships, single parenting as well as recipes, review and more.
